tooltip.the_long_travail.flavor.sun_chas: The heavens overturn—why does the golden crow close its eyes? As the black sun unfurls, I long only to draw my bow and cry aloud!
tooltip.the_long_travail.flavor.icarus: Wandering between the celestial sphere and the earth…
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.far_rea:
Sunset spills gold.
The sky shines clear.
“I come from far away…”

Sun blazes on fields of gold;
all things burn bright.
Here, legends set forth.

The traveler walks among them,
through the self's wasteland.

We are wayfarers in time;
by chance, our moments cross.

Wind and rain fill the ear.
Ahead, a lightless night.
So we walk with fire;
its flicker lights a corner.

The wilds stretch on.
Alone, we cross the waste.
tooltip.the_long_travail.far_reach.malic:
• When hit, remove 1 random beneficial effect, with a %1$s chance to remove all beneficial effects.

• When dealing damage, there is a %2$s chance to remove 1 random beneficial effect. This can trigger at most once every %3$s seconds.
tooltip.the_long_travail.far_reach.witne:
• New beneficial effects gain +%1$s levels.

• Every %2$s seconds, remove %3$s random harmful effects. If fewer harmful effects are available, gain one random beneficial effect for each missing effect. These beneficial effects last %4$s seconds.
